d: Anant Singh Daughter Wedding : apne bebak aur dabang andaj ke lie jane jane vale anant sinh in dinon apne bayan ko lekar nahin...balki ek aur bari vajah se charcha men hain.... aur vo vajah hai unki chhoti beti shivangi sinh ki shahi shadi.... ek aisi shadi, jismen anant sinh pani ki tarah paisa baha rahe hain.... 4 lakh mehmanon ki davat, 150 se jyada tarah ke pakvan, 10 bighe men aalishan pandal aur damad ko karib 3 karor rupye ki lagjari kar ka tohpha.... shadi ki taiyariyan dekhkar har koee hairan hai.... logon ke man men bas ek hi saval hai ki aakhir anant sinh apni beti ki shadi par…
